notes.title: 🎉European Festival Expansion🎶
notes.content:
[h1]New music and levels[/h1]

[previewyoutube=JCXkn9ETJt0;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]Hexagroove initially launched with 10 genres and 420 loops spanning classic genres such as House, Techno, and Drum & Bass.  Over the past year we've added more artists from Scotland and Japan with content updates. 

Now are proud to bring the music back home to Sweden with our European Festival expansion: thumping Deep House and frenetic Liquid Drum 'n Bass, topping 720 loops to build custom kits with.

[h1]A new place to play[/h1]

The European Festival Expansion also reaches for the stars and brings an entire new club to spin in, Rymd, on the suface of the moon itself! Aliens abduct party goers and lunar landers abound in our craziest club yet.  Play the native Liquid DnB by Big Skapinsky here, or any of the other 14 genres in our creative Freestyle mode.

[previewyoutube=ek_kJ75IOAM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Ask questions, follow us online![/h1]
We love to hear from you!  Start a discussion in the Steam Community Hub and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/hexagroove]Twitter[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/hexagrooveGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpmGA2gUf6nTw_-tLiPTE9w]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://instagram.com/hexagrooveGame]Instagram[/url] for pro tips on achievement-hunting and music-making.

Happy DJing,
/David

notes.title: Update for all you Hexagroovers out there!
notes.content:
We've now added an achievement feature to help you track it all in-game!

Also as the busy little worker bees we are we have polished the UI in multiple places.

Happy DJing this weekend!

notes.title: Demo update before tomorrows launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/30915c6ef22dc9c6e87151cc361e9f9b311d08db.jpg[/img]Hey Hexapeople, another update before the launch tomorrow October 27th!

We updated the demo with another fix, we added the Lead 2 instrument so players can get a deeper taste of the music before purchase.  Due to popular demand we have now also changed the demo level to include our Synthwave level rather than the Chiprock level.

Don't feel like the House and Synthwave level is enough? Join us for the stream where we will be showing you guys multiple venues and modes!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix October 16
notes.content:
Hey Hexa-people!

Just giving a heads up that we now have fixed the following issues:

[list]
[*] The help screen sometimes randomly disappeared, should now only disappear when you want it to.
[*] The key mapping for the Switch Pro Controller should now should the correct buttons.
[*] Sometimes the game would crash if you were using a mono sound card, should no longer be the case.
[/list]

Happy DJing!
